units-001.json

text:
Updated and re-validated `header.json` and `units-001.json` to close the finalize-before-subscribe gap:

- **`header.json` (`useRouteRef` decision)**: Updated the decision for [`useRouteRef`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L36-L51) so that in addition to subscribing via `routeResolutionApi.subscribe?.()` in `useEffect`, the effect immediately checks whether a route that resolved to `undefined` during the preceding render is now resolvable (`!renderedResolvedRef.current && routeResolutionApi.resolve(routeRef, { sourcePath: pathname }) !== undefined`) and increments `version` if so.
- **`U07` ([`useRouteRef.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx#L36-L51))**: Tracks `renderedResolvedRef.current = routeFunc !== undefined` and performs the immediate post-subscribe resolution check in `useEffect` with dependencies `[routeResolutionApi, routeRef, pathname]`.
- **`U02` ([`useRouteRef.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.test.tsx)) & `U03` ([`createSpecializedApp.test.tsx`](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-BF-08/packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx))**: Added reproducing test cases covering finalization occurring between the banner's initial bootstrap render and its `useEffect` subscription (via a sibling `app/root.elements` `useLayoutEffect` calling `preparedApp.finalize()`), while keeping all other units (`U01`, `U04`–`U06`, `U08`–`U11`) unchanged.
